Class DatabaseRepository.SqlRow

java.lang.Object
org.mavendb.loader.DatabaseRepository.SqlRow
Enclosing class:
DatabaseRepository
static final class DatabaseRepository.SqlRow extends Object
Parameter values of one gav row: the JDBC setter calls are recorded on a conversion thread, and replayed on the writer's PreparedStatement with the same setter and value types.

    • appendCopyEscaped

      static void appendCopyEscaped(StringBuilder sb, String str)
      Escape the characters COPY text format treats specially: backslash, and the row and column delimiters. MySQL LOAD DATA (ESCAPED BY '\\') decodes these the same way.
